Fixes the reported sylow_subgroup() IndexError (sympy/combinatorics/perm_groups.py, minimal_blocks).

Cause: in the minimality loop, `del num_blocks[i], blocks[i]` was executed inside the iteration over `rep_blocks`, reusing a rep_blocks index against num_blocks/blocks that had already shrunk from earlier deletions — a second out-of-range index raised IndexError. Fix: indices are recorded (`to_remove.append(i)`) and all three parallel lists are deleted together in `reversed()` order after the loop, so num_blocks, blocks and rep_blocks can never desynchronize. The `break` (minimal = False) path and the `num_block not in num_blocks` append path are unchanged.
